[[Category: Control Types]]

{{CT|intro

|macro = CT_MAP_MAIN
|value = 101
|description = A control that gives access to the map including markers. The ingame map that is opened with {{Controls|M}} uses this control type. [[CT_MAP_MAIN]] controls cannot be placed inside a [[CT_CONTROLS_GROUP]], because they are handled differently inside the engine due to their complexity. For more information see: {{Link|link= https://forums.bohemia.net/forums/topic/191876-map-control-not-positioned-correctly-using-ctrlcreate/?tab=comments#comment-3049009|text= BI Forums}}.
|gallery=
|commands =
* [[:Category:Command_Group:_GUI_Control_-_Map|Commands: Map]]
|events =
* [[User_Interface_Event_Handlers#onDraw|onDraw]]
}}
